routes.name: Véra / Colorsoft
prerequisites: Unlock the Kindle and connect a data-capable USB cable.
Use the exact firmware route selected by the official wizard.
Keep Wi-Fi enabled until the jailbreak has completed.
Prevent OTA updates before opening the exploit book.
manual_steps: Open kindlemodding.org/vera in the Kindle browser and download both books.
Configure Font Calibration with the exact official font and spacing values.
Open Véra and wait for RESTARTING GUI.
Confirm that the JAILBROKEN marker appears.
Run KPM commands from the Kindle search box.
Complete WeRead and Fanqie QR login from the device screen.
